svg.title: After a death: any coroner indication makes it a medicolegal case under the Coroner's Act; an expected natural death is certified by the doctor, who writes the cause of death in the WHO format, and a hospital autopsy needs informed authorization from the estate trustee or next of kin in order; the steps of an autopsy and what the death certificate is for are below
